question: Should this PR own static Codex price defaults and the extra fallback model, or should it be narrowed to recomputing generated Codex zeros only when pricing is already configured?
rationale: Static Codex price snapshots change upgrade-visible usage totals and can drift from upstream pricing, while the zero-cost resolver itself is a narrower accounting bug fix.

options.title: Narrow to resolver behavior
options.body: Keep the generated-Codex-zero recomputation path but remove the built-in static price table and fallback model unless a separate owner-approved catalog update lands.

options.title: Accept static Codex defaults
options.body: Land the static price table and fallback model as an intentional provider catalog default, with owners accepting future pricing-maintenance responsibility.

options.title: Pause or replace branch
options.body: Leave this PR blocked and open a narrower maintainer-owned replacement if the stale conflicting branch is not worth repairing.

recommendation.title: Narrow to resolver behavior
recommendation.body: Keep the generated-Codex-zero recomputation path but remove the built-in static price table and fallback model unless a separate owner-approved catalog update lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most relevant current-main history for Codex provider identity and OpenAI/Codex catalog behavior.
